user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Artist's Loft Studio. A sunlit artist's loft: a large easel holding a half-finished canvas, a paint-splattered floor, a rolling cart of brushes and paint tubes, stacked canvases against a brick wall, a sculpture stand with a clay bust, a ladder, and tall industrial windows with a skylight. Cloth drapes hang from a beam and warm light pools across the workspace. Style: bright painterly. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
